description: Create a VSCode task configuration file at .vscode/tasks.json in the workspace that runs the command 'python analyze_sales.py --input sales_data.csv --output report.json --verbose'. The tasks.json must have version 2.0.0, contain a tasks array with a task object that has type 'shell', command 'python', and args or command string that includes 'analyze_sales.py', '--input', 'sales_data.csv', '--output', 'report.json', and '--verbose'. The task must also have a label field with any descriptive name.
